name: Fake

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Same seed, same chats, messages and media.

chats.title: Number of chats
chats.description: Saved Messages, a bot, a group, a channel and a forum come first; the rest are private chats (every 7th a group).

latency_ms.title: Latency (ms)
latency_ms.description: Added to every request and to connecting.

transfer_chunk_ms.title: Transfer delay per 64 KiB (ms)
transfer_chunk_ms.description: Slows downloads and uploads so progress and cancel can be seen.

fail_rate.title: Random failure rate
fail_rate.description: Share of requests (0..1) failing with FLOOD_WAIT or NETWORK, drawn from a seeded RNG.

fail_script.title: Scripted failures
fail_script.description: method[#n]=CODE[:seconds], comma separated. Without #n every call fails. Example: messages.send#2=FLOOD_WAIT:7, media.download=NETWORK

start_state.title: Start state
start_state.description: auto: sign in unless a session is stored; connected: skip sign-in.

live_interval_ms.title: Live events every (ms)
live_interval_ms.description: 0 = off. Incoming messages, typing, presence, read receipts, reactions and edits.

description: Deterministic fake messenger for UI and end-to-end tests. Test code 12345, 2FA password 'fake'.
